description: Publish videos to a connected YouTube channel

actions.description: Upload a video to the connected YouTube channel

params.asset_ref: Reference to the recorded video asset to upload (required)
params.title: Video title, max 100 characters (required)
params.privacy_status: public, unlisted or private (optional; defaults to private)
params.publish_at: ISO-8601 instant to make the video public at (optional; requires privacy_status=private, and is silently ignored while the API project is unaudited)
